item.title: Court of Appeals upholds block on Trump Administration from clawing back dollars for clean-energy projects
item.description:
Publication Date: August 06, 2026

U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit, ruling en banc, upholds preliminary injunction in AG Ellison’s March 2025 lawsuit against illegal Trump attempt to block congressionally approved funding for state projects designed to reduce greenhouse gases
